Title: Monostate AItraining: Fine-tuning, RL, and inference in one CLI | Product Hunt
# Monostate AItraining. ## Fine-tuning, RL, and inference in one CLI. Fine-tune LLMs and ML models with automatic dataset conversion, hyperparameter sweeps, and custom RL environments - monostate/aitraining. Launch tags:Artificial Intelligence•GitHub•Tech. Framer AI AgentsDesign and publish professional sites with AI. I'm Andrew, the dev of AITraining. I built this because I kept losing time to trainer boilerplate instead of actually iterating on models. The other frustration was hardware—code that worked on NVIDIA would break on my Mac's MPS, and tools like HuggingFace's Autotrain didn't handle these edge cases well. AITraining wraps all of that into a CLI wizard that walks you through model selection, dataset conversion (auto-detects 6 formats), and training config. It supports SFT, DPO, ORPO, PPO, reward modeling, and knowledge distillation. After training, aitraining chat lets you test and compare iterations locally. Works on consumer hardware—auto-detects Apple Silicon vs CUDA and optimizes accordingly. Built on HuggingFace's ecosystem and open source (Apache 2.0). Docs available in English, Spanish, Chinese, and Portuguese. Would love to hear what training workflows or features you'd find useful. Title: Fragaria : CoT + RL = Reasoning: Self-improving AI reasoning engine for developers | Product Hunt
# Fragaria : CoT + RL = Reasoning. ## Self-improving AI reasoning engine for developers. Fragaria is an open-source AI reasoning API that combines Chain of Thought with Reinforcement Learning. It tackles complex problems, learns from each interaction and easily integrates with OpenAI, Groq, and Together.ai. Perfect for researchers and developers. Launch tags:API•Developer Tools•Artificial Intelligence. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Fragaria : CoT + RL = Reasoning. 👋 I'm thrilled to introduce Fragaria, a project born from the desire to push the boundaries of AI reasoning. Fragaria isn't just another language model wrapper. It's a sophisticated reasoning engine that grows smarter with every problem it solves. Here's what makes it special: 🧠 Chain of Thought (CoT) Reasoning: Fragaria breaks down complex problems into step-by-step solutions, providing transparency in its decision-making process. 🔄 Reinforcement Learning: Our novel approach combines CoT with RL, allowing Fragaria to continuously refine its problem-solving strategies. 🌐 Multi-Provider Support: Easily switch between OpenAI, Groq, and Together.ai as your LLM provider. 📈 Adaptive Learning: A SQLite-based scoring system helps Fragaria remember and improve upon successful strategies. 🔌 Easy Integration: With an OpenAI-compatible API, you can drop Fragaria into existing projects with minimal changes. 🔬 Research-Friendly: Designed for easy experimentation with different CoT strategies and RL algorithms. 🖥️ Interactive Demo: Includes a Svelte-based interface for visualizing the reasoning process. Whether you're a developer looking to enhance your AI capabilities, a researcher exploring new frontiers in machine reasoning, or just an AI enthusiast, Fragaria offers a playground for innovation. Try it out, contribute, or just explore the code: https://github.com/terraprompt/f... I'm excited to hear your thoughts and see what amazing applications you'll build with Fragaria. How would you use an AI that learns to reason better over time? Looks like a really promising AI tool. Haven't tried it yet but the reasoning engine idea seems super useful, especially for devs.

Title: UseDesktop: Verified RL environments and trajectory data for CUA | Product Hunt
# UseDesktop. ## Verified RL environments and trajectory data for CUA. UseDesktop is a vertically integrated pipeline for CUA data: capture real desktop workflows, normalize traces, build verifiers, run agent evals, and export RL task environments with high-quality trajectories. Computer-use agents do not need more toy tasks. They need long-horizon workflow data with evidence: where models fail, how success is verified, and whether training improves held-out tasks. Built for AI labs working on post-training, evaluation, and reinforcement learning for CUA. Launch tags:SaaS•Artificial Intelligence•YC Application. Render: Get up to $100K in startup credits. Render: Get up to $100K in startup creditsThe fastest way to deploy and scale apps and agents. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for UseDesktop. My name is Seungju from South Korea and I am the founder of UseDesktop. UseDesktop is the infrastructure for training Desktop Agent. Desktop Agent lives in your PC and acts based on what you showed them. It is different compared to other autonomous pro active agents like OpenClaw in the sense that its action is more deterministic making the result more. * Cheaper(in terms of token). It is designed privacy-first and you can connect local models to use it. At UseDesktop, you are able to. * Create Desktop Agent that will automate all your works. * Train actual finetuned model based on your own data. It was started with the motto of freeing Humans from labors. As We, humans, will gradually become managers managing hundreds of AI Agents that does the labor work for us. and If you need any help, you can reach out to me in the Discord or through my email.
